warnings: Relationship fields are unreviewed source hypotheses, not verified biological descent.
Never infer that all siblings of Jesus are sons of Mary.
Adam and Eve are erroneously described as siblings by the source: do not render this.
Relationships with '?' or unresolved/placeholder IDs require reconciliation.
The Gospels' Matthean/Lukan genealogies need a separate text-critical distinction.
